text:
ashok: FYI — trying to provision 4x A100s in ap-southeast2 for a customer POC, GCP keeps rejecting the request with a billing/verification error. Can someone from billing confirm what's missing? :grimacing:
maria: I see a hold on the account, payment method flagged. Bank returned 'card type mismatch' and 3DS required. Did you use a corporate card or personal?
ashok: Corporate card (Redwood Ltd). Stripe/Google are saying tax info mismatch too — VAT ID vs company name. The account was created from our APAC onboarding flow.
billing-bot: Automated alert: payment_method_declined - requires_3ds. Support ticket created: #BILL-4382.
kevin: Tagging infra — this will block capacity allocation. If we can't get APAC A100s provisioned today we should plan fallback to us-west1 with preemptible A100s for the POC. Latency will be worse but it's a stopgap.
maria: @ashok can you forward the billing email? Also finance needs a copy of the company registration doc and updated W-8/W-9 depending on entity type.
ashok: Forwarded. The GCP console shows: "Account verification required: Provide tax ID and complete 3DS for card." Screenshot pasted.
finance-sre: If it's tax ID mismatch, GCP may require alternate docs (W-8BEN-E for non-US). Let's not share sensitive docs in channel — I'll open a secure share link.
oncall: Quick heads-up from oncall: cluster autoscaler already attempted to create the node pool and saw ENI limit warnings in ap-southeast2. Even if billing clears, we might hit regional network interface quotas for large instances.
kevin: Good catch. ap-southeast2 default project ENI quota is 8 per region, A100 VMs use multiple ENIs depending on setup. We should request quota increase from GCP while billing is sorted.
emma: Customer kickoff is tomorrow morning APAC time. Any manual escalation we can do? Sales is on standby.
maria: I'll accelerate the verification with finance. But banks sometimes require the 3DS auth flow which only the card owner can complete. If the card is company-managed, ask the card admin to accept the 3DS challenge.
ashok: Card admin is @tom (out today). Is there a grace path?
maria: We can request temporary manual approval from GCP billing team but they require proof of identity + company docs. I'm preparing the packet now.
kevin: Parallel actions: (1) @maria escalate KYC to expedite, (2) @finance-sre open GCP quota increase for ENIs and GPUs in ap-southeast2, (3) infra oncall prepare fallback cluster in us-west1.
ashok: Noted. ETA for documents?
maria: I can get docs uploaded within 2 hours if @tom can do the 3DS. If not, expect 4-6 hours for manual verification.
finance-sre: Quota request submitted: GCP case #GCQ-9021 — requesting ENI increase to 64 and A100 GPU quota to 16 for project redwood-prod-apac. No ETA.
oncall: I've added a temporary alert rule to notify infra if nodepool creation fails again. Also logging the error string: "PERMISSION_DENIED: billing account not verified" and "QUOTA_EXCEEDED: network interfaces" for triage.
emma: I'll notify customer of potential delay and offer an alternate timezone for the kickoff. Keep me posted.
kevin: Small optimization note: if we end up in us-west fallback, we can route traffic through our regional ingress and use the Redwood routing policy to prefer ap-southeast cached responses to reduce latency penalty.
maria: Update: finance confirmed the business registration docs are complete. Waiting on @tom to complete 3DS. If he can't, we file a bank dispute route which takes longer.
ashok: Tom just responded, doing 3DS now. Thanks.
kevin: If verification completes, remember to re-run the provisioning job with --node-label=apac-test to avoid colliding with prod pools. Command: ```gcloud compute instances create ... --accelerator type=nvidia-tesla-a100 --region=ap-southeast2 --network-interface=nic0```
ashok: Will do.
maria: Billing update: GCP accepted documents and completed manual verification at 1785126000. Card 3DS succeeded at 1785126100. Manual hold cleared.
finance-sre: GCP case GCQ-9021 updated — quota approved for ENIs / GPUs but it may take up to 30 minutes to propagate.
oncall: Nodepool creation re-attempt succeed?
kevin: Just kicked off a retry. Logs show node creation in progress, no ENI errors now.
emma: Great — I'll message the customer that we can proceed with kickoff as planned.
ashok: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: let's document the APAC onboarding checklist (tax docs, 3DS, request ENI quota) so next time this doesn't block provisioning. :memo:
maria: Agreed — I'll create a short runbook and link it in #devex. :+1:
ashok: Closing thread once infra confirms instances running.
kevin: Instances up and ready at 1785127120. Closing. :rocket:
